title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of State Security on Issues Concerning Jurisdiction over Cases of Insulting the National Flag and National Emblem of the People's Republic of China
keywords_en: cases concerning the national flag and national emblem of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate

Ministry of Public Security Ministry of State Security

Notice on the Jurisdiction of Cases Concerning Insulting the National Flag and National Emblem of the People's Republic of China

Gongtongzi [1991] No. 89

To: The High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and State Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government

Pursuant to the "Decision on Punishing the Crime of Insulting the National Flag and National Emblem of the People's Republic of China" adopted at the 14th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the Seventh National People's Congress, notice is hereby given on the jurisdiction of cases concerning insulting the national flag and national emblem of the People's Republic of China as follows:

Cases of insulting the national flag or national emblem of the People's Republic of China shall be placed on file and investigated by the public security organs.

September 19, 1991
